stem: Which quotation from the excerpt shows that Thea's room serves as a place for reflection?

options.label: A
options.text: It was the end room of the wing, and was not plastered, but was snugly lined with soft pine. (paragraph 2)

options.label: B
options.text: She was not allowed to take a lamp upstairs, so Ray Kennedy gave her a railroad lantern by which she could read at night. (paragraph 2)

options.label: C
options.text: It was one of the most important things that ever happened to her. (paragraph 5)

options.label: D
options.text: In the end of the wing, separated from the other upstairs sleeping-rooms by a long, cold, unfinished lumber room, her mind worked better. (paragraph 5)

visual_elements: multiple choice question with four text options
